check("two_sum([2, 7, 11, 15], 9)", lambda: two_sum([2, 7, 11, 15], 9), [0, 1])
check("two_sum([3, 2, 4], 6)", lambda: two_sum([3, 2, 4], 6), [1, 2])
check("duplicate values: two_sum([3, 3], 6)", lambda: two_sum([3, 3], 6), [0, 1])
check("negatives: two_sum([-3, 4, 3, 90], 0)", lambda: two_sum([-3, 4, 3, 90], 0), [0, 2])
check("zeros: two_sum([0, 4, 3, 0], 0)", lambda: two_sum([0, 4, 3, 0], 0), [0, 3])
check("no self-pairing: two_sum([5, 1, 5], 10)", lambda: two_sum([5, 1, 5], 10), [0, 2])
check("pair at the end: two_sum([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 9)", lambda: two_sum([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 9), [3, 4])
check("large input (100,000 values)", lambda: two_sum(list(range(100_000)), 199_997), [99_998, 99_999])

def normalise_groups(groups):
    """Sort inside each group and sort the groups, so any output order compares equal."""
    return sorted(sorted(group) for group in groups)

check(
    "group_anagrams groups anagrams",
    lambda: sorted(sorted(g) for g in group_anagrams(["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"])),
    [["ate", "eat", "tea"], ["bat"], ["nat", "tan"]],
)
check("empty string: group_anagrams([''])", lambda: normalise_groups(group_anagrams([""])), [[""]])
check("empty input: group_anagrams([])", lambda: normalise_groups(group_anagrams([])), [])
check("single word", lambda: normalise_groups(group_anagrams(["a"])), [["a"]])
check(
    "repeated words stay in the group",
    lambda: normalise_groups(group_anagrams(["ab", "ba", "ab"])),
    [["ab", "ab", "ba"]],
)
check(
    "letter counts matter, not just letter sets",
    lambda: normalise_groups(group_anagrams(["abc", "abcc", "cab", "aab", "abb"])),
    [["aab"], ["abb"], ["abc", "cab"], ["abcc"]],
)
check(
    "no anagrams at all",
    lambda: normalise_groups(group_anagrams(["abc", "def", "ghi"])),
    [["abc"], ["def"], ["ghi"]],

check("top_k_frequent([1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3], 2)", lambda: sorted(top_k_frequent([1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3], 2)), [1, 2])
check("top_k_frequent([1], 1)", lambda: top_k_frequent([1], 1), [1])
check(
    "ranks by count, not by value or first appearance",
    lambda: sorted(top_k_frequent([5, 5, 5, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3], 2)),
    [2, 5],
)
check("most frequent is not first: k=1", lambda: top_k_frequent([3, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2], 1), [2])
check("negatives", lambda: sorted(top_k_frequent([-1, -1, -2, -2, -2, 3], 2)), [-2, -1])
check("zero as a value", lambda: top_k_frequent([0, 0, 1], 1), [0])
check("k equals the number of distinct values", lambda: sorted(top_k_frequent([4, 5, 6], 3)), [4, 5, 6])
check(
    "large input (100,000 values)",
    lambda: top_k_frequent([i % 1000 for i in range(100_000)] + [7] * 5, 1),
    [7],

check("product_except_self([1, 2, 3, 4])", lambda: product_except_self([1, 2, 3, 4]), [24, 12, 8, 6])
check(
    "product_except_self with zeros",
    lambda: product_except_self([-1, 1, 0, -3, 3]),
    [0, 0, 9, 0, 0],
)
check("one zero: [2, 0, 3]", lambda: product_except_self([2, 0, 3]), [0, 6, 0])
check("two zeros: [0, 2, 0]", lambda: product_except_self([0, 2, 0]), [0, 0, 0])
check("two elements: [3, 5]", lambda: product_except_self([3, 5]), [5, 3])
check("all negatives: [-1, -2, -3]", lambda: product_except_self([-1, -2, -3]), [6, 3, 2])
check("all duplicates: [1, 1, 1, 1]", lambda: product_except_self([1, 1, 1, 1]), [1, 1, 1, 1])
check(
    "large input (100,000 values)",
    lambda: product_except_self([1] * 99_999 + [2]),
    [2] * 99_999 + [1],

check("longest_consecutive([100, 4, 200, 1, 3, 2])", lambda: longest_consecutive([100, 4, 200, 1, 3, 2]), 4)
check(
    "longest_consecutive with duplicates",
    lambda: longest_consecutive([0, 3, 7, 2, 5, 8, 4, 6, 0, 1]),
    9,
)
check("longest_consecutive([]) == 0", lambda: longest_consecutive([]), 0)
check("single value", lambda: longest_consecutive([5]), 1)
check("all duplicates", lambda: longest_consecutive([7, 7, 7]), 1)
check("duplicate inside a run: [1, 2, 2, 3]", lambda: longest_consecutive([1, 2, 2, 3]), 3)
check("negatives across zero", lambda: longest_consecutive([-2, -1, 0, 1, 5]), 4)
check("no two values consecutive", lambda: longest_consecutive([10, 30, 20]), 1)
check("large input in reverse order (100,000 values)", lambda: longest_consecutive(list(range(100_000, 0, -1))), 100_000)
